description: This file defines the enum LoanTransactionType, which categorizes various types of loan transactions within the loan account domain of the Apache Fineract project. It includes transaction type constants, a mapping from integers to types, and methods for identifying specific transaction characteristics.

classes.name: LoanTransactionType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different types of loan transactions, providing utility methods for type identification and conversion from integer codes.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Creates a LoanTransactionType enum from an integer code, defaulting to INVALID if the code does not match.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with this transaction type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with this transaction type.

methods.name: isDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a disbursement.

methods.name: isRepaymentAtDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a repayment at disbursement.

methods.name: isRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a repayment.

methods.name: isInterestPaymentWaiver
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an interest payment waiver.

methods.name: isMerchantIssuedRefund
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a merchant issued refund.

methods.name: isPayoutRefund
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a payout refund.

methods.name: isGoodwillCredit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a goodwill credit.

methods.name: isChargeRefund
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a charge refund.

methods.name: isRepaymentType
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type qualifies as a repayment type, including merchant refunds, payout refunds, goodwill credits, charge refunds, down payments, or interest payment waivers.

methods.name: isRecoveryRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a recovery repayment.

methods.name: isWaiveInterest
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a waive interest.

methods.name: isWaiveCharges
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a waive charges.

methods.name: isAccrual
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an accrual.

methods.name: isWriteOff
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a write-off.

methods.name: isChargePayment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a charge payment.

methods.name: isRefundForActiveLoan
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a refund for an active loan.

methods.name: isIncomePosting
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an income posting.

methods.name: isChargeback
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a chargeback.

methods.name: isChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a charge adjustment.

methods.name: isChargeOff
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a charge off.

methods.name: isReAge
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a re-age.

methods.name: isReAmortize
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a re-amortization.

methods.name: isDownPayment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a down payment.

methods.name: isAccrualActivity
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an accrual activity.

methods.name: isInterestRefund
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an interest refund.

methods.name: isAccrualAdjustment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an accrual adjustment.

methods.name: isCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is for capitalized income.

methods.name: isCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a capitalized income adjustment.

methods.name: isContractTermination
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a contract termination.

methods.name: isBuyDownFee
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a buy-down fee.

methods.name: isBuyDownFeeAdjustment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a buy-down fee adjustment.
